tka.none.zh: 所有人（不限自定义受众）

tka.hint.en: TikTok needs {min} people in an audience before it delivers; a new one takes up to 48 hours to fill. For retargeting, leave out the buyers.
tka.hint.zh: 受众至少要有 {min} 人 TikTok 才会投放；新建的受众最多需要 48 小时填充。做再营销时，请排除已购买的人。

tka.chooseAccount.en: Custom audiences belong to one ad account: choose exactly one in step 2 to pick its audiences.
tka.chooseAccount.zh: 自定义受众属于单个广告账户：请在第 2 步只选择一个广告账户，再选择它的受众。

tka.loading.zh: 正在读取该广告账户的受众…

tka.idHint.en: The number in Audience Manager's ID column.
tka.idHint.zh: 受众管理中 ID 一列的数字。

tka.savedNote.en: These are the audiences saved in Studio. TikTok doesn't let Studio read its live list yet, so their sizes aren't shown.
tka.savedNote.zh: 这些是 Studio 里保存的受众。TikTok 暂时不允许 Studio 读取实时列表，所以不显示人数。

tka.noneSaved.en: No audiences are saved in Studio for this ad account yet, and TikTok doesn't let Studio read its list. Use one by ID below.
tka.noneSaved.zh: Studio 还没有为该广告账户保存受众，TikTok 也暂不允许读取列表。可在下方按 ID 使用。

tka.byIdSummary.zh: 按 ID 使用其他受众
